intro: A question bank written by people who study on Alumia. The answer key only shows up after you answer.
regra: The order is newest to oldest, the same for everyone. A question does not show who wrote it. Your answer is checked and not stored: your scores stay only on this device.

materia.nenhuma: There are no questions yet. How about writing the first one?

questao.respondida: You already answered this one on this device.

denuncia.titulo: What is wrong with this question?
denuncia.enviada: Report sent to moderation. It does not store who reported.

acertos.nada: You have not answered any question on this device yet.
acertos.nota: Only you see this, and only here: none of it goes to the server or shows to other people. The first answer to each question is the one that counts. The "Quick exit" button also erases it.
acertos.apagar: Erase my scores from this device
acertos.confirmar: Erase the scores stored on this device? This cannot be undone.

escrever.intro: Write carefully: people who answer trust the answer key. Formulas, code and statement images go in through formatted text.
escrever.temaDica: E.g.: quadratic functions, Haitian Revolution, loops
escrever.semNome: The question does not show who wrote it. You can edit and delete yours in "My questions".

problemas.alternativa: Every option needs text (up to 500 characters).
problemas.certa: Mark which option is the right one.

minhas.nada: You have not written any question yet.

mediacao.nota: A report does not store who reported, and a question does not show who wrote it. Removing takes the question out of the bank; keeping clears the queue.

fim: There are no more questions here.

erros.falha: That did not work right now. Try again in a moment.
erros.consentimento: Join Alumia to see and write questions.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove the personal data (ID number, phone, e-mail or street address with number).
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a little.
erros.invalido:propria: You cannot report your own question: edit or delete it.
erros.invalido:muitas: You reached the limit of 200 questions. Delete an old one to write another.
